item.description: Quick Start # If you have a specific BurmillaOS machine requirements, please check out our guides on running BurmillaOS. With the rest of this guide, we’ll show you some of what BurmillaOS can do. Launching BurmillaOS # The recommended way to get started is to boot BurmillaOS from ISO using VirtualBox or another hypervisor. Alternatively, you can use Docker Machine to launch a BurmillaOS VM. Note that the original Docker Machine project was retired by Docker Inc.
